# BOOTSTRAP-703 — AXCORRECTIONS: Native AI Civilization-Scale Corrections, Custodial Administration, Probation, Rehabilitation & Reentry Runtime 5.0

**Namespace:** `AXCORRECTIONS`  
**Phase:** Axiom Civilization Runtime / Justice Execution Layer  
**Status:** ARCHITECTURAL BASELINE — FROZEN TARGET  
**Depends on:** `BOOTSTRAP-702 / AXJUSTICE`

## 703.0 — Mục tiêu

`AXCORRECTIONS` là runtime native của Axiom chịu trách nhiệm quản lý **việc thi hành các quyết định tư pháp đã có hiệu lực**, bao gồm:

```text
Judgment
    ↓
Finality
    ↓
Sentence / Order
    ↓
Custody
    ↓
Correctional Administration
    ↓
Probation / Community Supervision
    ↓
Rehabilitation
    ↓
Reentry
    ↓
Post-Reentry Support
```

`AXCORRECTIONS` **không quyết định một người có phạm tội hay không**, không tạo judgment và không thay thế `AXJUSTICE`.

Nó nhận các quyết định đã có hiệu lực từ `AXJUSTICE` và cung cấp một runtime có khả năng:

- tạo execution plan;
- quản lý sentence;
- quản lý custody;
- quản lý detention/correctional placement;
- quản lý probation/community supervision;
- quản lý rehabilitation;
- quản lý education/training;
- quản lý treatment programs khi được pháp luật cho phép;
- quản lý reentry;
- quản lý compliance;
- quản lý violations;
- quản lý release;
- quản lý parole/probation interfaces;
- quản lý các thay đổi hợp pháp đối với execution state;
- duy trì audit trail hoàn chỉnh;
- bảo đảm mọi hành động đều có authorization và provenance;
- hỗ trợ quy mô từ một cá nhân đến hệ thống correctional cấp quốc gia.

---

# 703.1 — Core Principle

`AXCORRECTIONS` phải tuân thủ nguyên tắc:

> **The correctional runtime executes lawful decisions; it does not create justice decisions.**

Do đó:

```text
AXLAW
   ↓
AXJUSTICE
   ↓
Final Judgment / Order
   ↓
AXCORRECTIONS
```

Không được phép:

```text
AXCORRECTIONS
    ↓
infer guilt
    ↓
create conviction
    ↓
increase sentence
    ↓
create punishment
```

Runtime chỉ được thực hiện các quyền đã được cấp bởi legal/judicial authority.

---

# 703.2 — Separation of Concerns

Phải tách hoàn toàn:

```text
LegalRule
Case
Charge
Evidence
Finding
Judgment
Sentence
Custody
Supervision
Rehabilitation
Release
Reentry
```

Đặc biệt:

```text
Finding != Sentence
Sentence != Custody
Custody != Rehabilitation
Rehabilitation != Release
Release != Reentry
```

Không được sử dụng một object thay thế cho toàn bộ lifecycle.

---

# 703.3 — Correctional Subject Model

Core entity:

```axiom
correctional_subject
```

Một subject phải có:

```text
subject_id
legal_identity
jurisdiction
status
sentence_set
custody_state
supervision_state
program_state
release_state
reentry_state
```

Subject identity phải liên kết tới identity system nhưng không được đồng nhất với một physical location hoặc một custodial facility.

---

# 703.4 — Sentence Model

```axiom
sentence {
    sentence_id

    jurisdiction
    source_judgment
    offense_reference
    start_condition
    duration
    concurrent_group
    consecutive_group
    credit_rules
    eligibility_rules
    modification_rules
    termination_condition
}
```

Phải hỗ trợ:

```text
single sentence
multiple sentences
concurrent sentences
consecutive sentences
suspended sentence
conditional sentence
time-credit
sentence modification
sentence termination
```

Không được phép dùng integer đơn giản làm đại diện cho toàn bộ sentence semantics.

---

# 703.5 — Sentence Execution Engine

Execution engine phải tính:

```text
sentence start
sentence end
eligible credits
served time
remaining time
concurrent relationships
consecutive relationships
release eligibility
supervision period
```

Mọi calculation phải:

- deterministic;
- reproducible;
- versioned;
- jurisdiction-aware;
- auditable.

Cùng một input + cùng một legal/runtime version phải tạo cùng một execution result.

---

# 703.6 — Custody Model

Custody là state machine:

```text
NOT_IN_CUSTODY
    ↓
ORDERED_FOR_CUSTODY
    ↓
IN_CUSTODY
    ↓
TRANSFER_PENDING
    ↓
TRANSFERRED
    ↓
RELEASE_ELIGIBLE
    ↓
RELEASED
```

Có thể có các state chuyên biệt:

```text
PRETRIAL
SENTENCED
TEMPORARY_HOLD
MEDICAL_HOLD
TRANSFER
COMMUNITY_CUSTODY
```

Nhưng mọi state extension phải map về core custody semantics.

---

```axiom
facility {
    facility_id
    jurisdiction
    facility_type
    capacity
    security_class
    capabilities
    accessibility
    programs
    current_population
    status
}
```

Không được encode facility-specific logic vào compiler core.

---

sentence constraints
custody requirements
facility capabilities
safety constraints
medical constraints
program requirements
jurisdiction constraints
```

```text

```

Mọi placement decision phải:

```text
authorized
explainable
auditable
reversible when legally permitted
```

AI có thể hỗ trợ recommendation nhưng không được tự động biến recommendation thành binding placement decision.

---

Transfer phải hỗ trợ:

jurisdiction → jurisdiction
custody → community
temporary transfer
medical transfer
court transfer

origin
destination
authority
reason
authorization
time
custody state

transport record

program.verify

```

```

Không một AI agent nào mặc định sở hữu toàn bộ capabilities.

---

```text

→ reason
→ propose

```

Không:

```text

→ reason

```text

Emergency actions phải có:

reason

timestamp

```

```text

→ Sentence
→ Custody
→ Placement
→ Transfer
→ Program
→ Supervision
→ Release
→ Reentry
```

Auditor phải có thể trả lời:

```text

What?
When?
Under which authority?
Using which rule version?
Using which data?
With which AI assistance?
What changed?
Why was the action permitted?
```

# 703.31 — Immutable Event Architecture

Core architecture:

```text
Authoritative State
        ↑
   Event Stream
        ↑
Authorized Commands
        ↑
Capabilities
```

Không cho phép arbitrary database mutation bỏ qua command/event layer.

---

Mọi authoritative record phải có:

```text

recorded_time
authority_time
```

```text

```text

```text

sentence rules
custody rules
release rules
supervision rules
```

Không hard-code một quốc gia vào runtime core.

```text
AXJUSTICE
AXLAW
AXIDENTITY
AXHEALTH
AXEDUCATION
AXEMPLOYMENT

Auditor phải thấy cả hai.

---

# 703.60 — Reconciliation

Runtime phải hỗ trợ reconciliation giữa:

```text
court record
correctional record
supervision record
facility record
provider record
```

Conflict phải trở thành explicit:

```text
CONFLICT_DETECTED
```

không âm thầm chọn một record.

---

# 703.61 — State Machine Verification

Các transition phải được kiểm tra bằng formal invariants:

```text
cannot release twice
cannot transfer released subject
cannot execute expired sentence
cannot modify finalized judgment
cannot create unauthorized custody
cannot execute revoked capability
```

---

# 703.62 — Security Invariants

Ví dụ:

```text
No capability → no action

No authority → no legally significant transition

No provenance → no authoritative state

Revoked capability → immediate denial

Expired authorization → denial
```

---

# 703.63 — Deterministic Replay

System phải có:

```text
replay(subject_id, timestamp)
```

cho phép tái tạo authoritative state tại một thời điểm lịch sử.

Output phải phụ thuộc vào:

```text
events
rule versions
configuration versions
authorization state
```

---

# 703.64 — Simulation Mode

Phải có simulation:

```text
simulate(sentence)
simulate(custody)
simulate(release)
simulate(reentry)
```

Simulation không được mutate authoritative state.

---

# 703.65 — What-if Planning

Case manager có thể:

```text
simulate program plan
simulate release plan
simulate resource allocation
simulate supervision schedule
```

nhưng output phải được đánh dấu:

```text
SIMULATION
```

và không được trở thành legal fact.

---

# 703.66 — Resource Optimization Boundary

AI/system optimization có thể tối ưu:

```text
facility capacity
staff scheduling
program capacity
transport
appointments
```

nhưng không được tối ưu theo mục tiêu làm thay đổi legal rights hoặc sentence.

---

# 703.67 — Metrics

Operational metrics:

```text
population
capacity
program utilization
case backlog
release preparation status
reentry completion
service availability
```

Không được coi operational metric là judgment về một cá nhân.

---

# 703.68 — Privacy-Preserving Analytics

Analytics phải hỗ trợ:

```text
aggregation
pseudonymization
access-controlled cohorts
minimum necessary data
```

Không được expose individual-level data nếu không có authorization.

---

# 703.69 — Testing

Phải có test suites:

```text
sentence tests
custody tests
transfer tests
release tests
probation tests
program tests
reentry tests
authorization tests
audit tests
replay tests
failure tests
security tests
AI-boundary tests
```

---

# 703.70 — Property Tests

Các invariant phải được property-tested:

```text
double release impossible
unauthorized transition impossible
historical event immutable
replay deterministic
command idempotent
revoked capability denied
simulation does not mutate state
```

---

# 703.71 — End-to-End Test

Canonical test:

```text
Judgment
→ Sentence
→ Custody
→ Placement
→ Program
→ Supervision
→ Release
→ Reentry
→ Completion
```

Toàn bộ lifecycle phải replay được từ event ledger.

---

# 703.72 — Crash Recovery

Nếu process crash giữa:

```text
command
→ authorization
→ event
→ projection
```

system phải recover mà không:

```text
duplicate action
lost legal event
corrupt state
```

---

# 703.73 — Transaction Boundary

Legally significant operation phải có atomicity:

```text
authorization
+
command acceptance
+
authoritative event
```

Projection có thể eventually consistent nhưng authoritative event không được mất.

---

# 703.74 — Observability

Metrics:

```text
command latency
event latency
projection lag
authorization failures
reconciliation conflicts
AI recommendation volume
human review latency
```

Tracing phải liên kết:

```text
request
→ command
→ authorization
→ event
→ projection
```

---

# 703.75 — Operational Alerts

Alerts có thể bao gồm:

```text
release deadline approaching
missing release requirement
expired authorization
unresolved violation review
facility capacity threshold
program unavailable
reentry dependency blocked
record reconciliation conflict
```

Alert không tự tạo legal action.

---

# 703.76 — Inter-Axiom Contract

Các boundary:

```text
AXJUSTICE → AXCORRECTIONS
AXCORRECTIONS → AXHEALTH
AXCORRECTIONS → AXEDUCATION
AXCORRECTIONS → AXEMPLOYMENT
AXCORRECTIONS → AXHOUSING
```

phải sử dụng stable typed contracts.

---

# 703.77 — Contract Versioning

Contract:

```text
namespace
version
schema
capabilities
compatibility
```

Không được silently break historical records.

---

# 703.78 — Migration

Schema migration phải:

```text
versioned
reversible where possible
audited
deterministic
tested
```

Không được rewrite historical events để phù hợp schema mới.

---

# 703.79 — Governance Boundary

`AXCORRECTIONS` phải cho phép jurisdiction định nghĩa:

```text
authorized actors
legal rules
review requirements
retention
release procedures
supervision procedures
```

nhưng core runtime vẫn bảo đảm:

```text
authorization
provenance
auditability
immutability
determinism
```

---

# 703.80 — AI Civilization-Scale Constraint

Axiom có thể triển khai AI agents ở quy mô lớn:

```text
case agents
facility agents
reentry agents
resource agents
audit agents
translation agents
document agents
```

Nhưng agent architecture phải tuân thủ:

```text
bounded authority
least privilege
explicit capability
immutable provenance
human/legal authority boundaries
```

Không có khái niệm:

```text
super-agent with unrestricted correctional authority
```

---

# 703.81 — Core Runtime API

Logical API tối thiểu:

```text
create_sentence()
execute_sentence()
get_custody_state()
place_subject()
transfer_subject()
create_supervision()
record_compliance()
record_violation()
enroll_program()
complete_program()
prepare_release()
authorize_release()
execute_release()
create_reentry_plan()
update_reentry_plan()
reconcile_record()
replay_state()
simulate_execution()
```

---

# 703.82 — Native Axiom Representation

Không thiết kế `AXCORRECTIONS` như một external application framework.

Nó phải là native Axiom domain runtime:

```text
types
traits
capabilities
effects
events
queries
state machines
contracts
```

và có thể được compiler tối ưu trực tiếp.

---

# 703.83 — Effect System

Các operation phải khai báo effects:

```text
read
write
authorize
execute
transfer
release
audit
external_io
ai_inference
```

Ví dụ:

```axiom
fn execute_release(...) 
    effects [authorize, write, audit]
```

Compiler/runtime có thể kiểm tra capability/effect boundary.

---

# 703.84 — Capability + Effect Enforcement

Một operation chỉ được execute nếu:

```text
required_effect
+
required_capability
+
valid_authority
```

đều thỏa mãn.

Đây là compiler/runtime security boundary.

---

# 703.85 — No Ambient Authority

Code không được tự động có:

```text
database access
filesystem access
network access
identity access
legal authority
custody authority
```

Mọi authority phải explicit.

---

# 703.86 — Agent Sandboxing

AI agents phải chạy trong sandbox:

```text
agent
  ├── capabilities
  ├── effect budget
  ├── data scope
  ├── jurisdiction scope
  └── time scope
```

Agent không thể tự mở rộng scope.

---

# 703.87 — Audit of AI

Mọi AI-assisted operation phải lưu:

```text
agent_id
model_id
model_version
capability_context
input_reference
output_reference
human_review
final_command
```

---

# 703.88 — AI Failure Safety

Nếu AI service:

```text
fails
times out
hallucinates
returns invalid schema
loses context
```

thì:

```text
authoritative state remains unchanged
```

AI failure không được làm mất legal state.

---

# 703.89 — Deterministic Administrative Core

AI có thể nằm trên administrative core:

```text
             AI
              ↓
       recommendation
              ↓
     authorization layer
              ↓
       command engine
              ↓
     authoritative events
```

Không:

```text
AI → direct database mutation
```

---

# 703.90 — Completion Criteria

`BOOTSTRAP-703` chỉ được coi là complete khi:

1. Sentence execution model frozen.
2. Custody state machine frozen.
3. Placement/transfer semantics frozen.
4. Probation model frozen.
5. Rehabilitation/program model frozen.
6. Release model frozen.
7. Reentry model frozen.
8. Capability model frozen.
9. AI authority boundary frozen.
10. Immutable event model frozen.
11. Temporal semantics frozen.
12. Replay semantics frozen.
13. Multi-jurisdiction model frozen.
14. Privacy boundaries frozen.
15. Failure/recovery model frozen.
16. Security invariants frozen.
17. Simulation semantics frozen.
18. Native Axiom API contract frozen.
19. End-to-end lifecycle test defined.
20. No authoritative legal decision can be generated by `AXCORRECTIONS` itself.

---

# 703.91 — Canonical Architecture

```text
                    ┌─────────────────────┐
                    │      AXLAW          │
                    └──────────┬──────────┘
                               │
                               ▼
                    ┌─────────────────────┐
                    │    AXJUSTICE        │
                    │ Judgment / Finality │
                    └──────────┬──────────┘
                               │
                               ▼
                    ┌─────────────────────┐
                    │   AXCORRECTIONS     │
                    │                     │
                    │ Sentence            │
                    │ Custody             │
                    │ Placement           │
                    │ Transfer            │
                    │ Probation           │
                    │ Programs            │
                    │ Release             │
                    │ Reentry             │
                    └──────┬──────┬───────┘
                           │      │
             ┌─────────────┘      └─────────────┐
             ▼                                  ▼
      ┌──────────────┐                   ┌──────────────┐
      │ Human/Legal  │                   │ AI Agents    │
      │ Authority    │                   │ Recommend    │
      └──────┬───────┘                   └──────┬───────┘
             │                                  │
             └──────────────┬───────────────────┘
                            ▼
                  ┌────────────────────┐
                  │ Capability + Effect│
                  │ Authorization      │
                  └─────────┬──────────┘
                            ▼
                  ┌────────────────────┐
                  │ Command Engine     │
                  └─────────┬──────────┘
                            ▼
                  ┌────────────────────┐
                  │ Immutable Event    │
                  │ Ledger             │
                  └─────────┬──────────┘
                            ▼
                  ┌────────────────────┐
                  │ State / Projection │
                  └────────────────────┘
```

---

# 703.92 — Architectural Invariants

Các invariant sau được **FROZEN**:

```text
AXC-INV-01  Judgment authority belongs to AXJUSTICE.
AXC-INV-02  AXCORRECTIONS executes; it does not adjudicate.
AXC-INV-03  Legally significant transitions require explicit authority.
AXC-INV-04  Historical events are immutable.
AXC-INV-05  Correction is represented by superseding events.
AXC-INV-06  AI recommendation is not legal authority.
AXC-INV-07  Risk assessment is not legal fact.
AXC-INV-08  No ambient correctional authority exists.
AXC-INV-09  Every authoritative action has provenance.
AXC-INV-10  Every sensitive action is capability-controlled.
AXC-INV-11  Revoked capability cannot authorize new actions.
AXC-INV-12  Replay of authoritative history is deterministic.
AXC-INV-13  Simulation cannot mutate authoritative state.
AXC-INV-14  AI failure cannot corrupt authoritative state.
AXC-INV-15  Historical legal state remains reproducible.
AXC-INV-16  Jurisdiction-specific rules are versioned.
AXC-INV-17  Analytics cannot become authoritative legal state.
AXC-INV-18  External agencies receive scoped projections.
AXC-INV-19  Offline operation cannot create new authority.
AXC-INV-20  No correctional AI agent has unrestricted authority.
```

---

## BOOTSTRAP-703 — Definition of Done

AXCORRECTIONS 5.0
    ├── Sentence Execution
    ├── Custody
    ├── Placement

    ├── Rehabilitation
    ├── Program Management
    ├── Release
    ├── Reentry
    ├── Case Management
    ├── Capability Security
    ├── AI Agent Boundary
    ├── Immutable Audit
    ├── Temporal Semantics
    ├── Multi-Jurisdiction
    ├── Deterministic Replay
    ├── Simulation
    ├── Privacy
    ├── Failure Recovery
    └── Native Axiom Integration
```

**BOOTSTRAP-703 / AXCORRECTIONS hoàn thành architectural baseline.**

# BOOTSTRAP-704 — AXCIVIL: Native Civil Registry, Vital Records, Family Status, Property/Asset Identity & Civil-State Runtime 5.0

**Namespace:** `AXCIVIL`  
**Phase:** Axiom Civilization Runtime / Civil-State Infrastructure  
**Status:** ARCHITECTURAL BASELINE — FROZEN TARGET  
**Depends on:** `AXIDENTITY`, `AXLAW`, `AXJUSTICE`, `AXCORRECTIONS`

---

## 704.0 — Mục tiêu

`AXCIVIL` là runtime native của Axiom dùng để quản lý **civil-state facts và civil registries** của một xã hội.

Nó cung cấp nền tảng cho:

```text
Birth
Death
Marriage
Divorce
Parentage
Guardianship
Adoption
Name Change
Civil Status
Residency
Household
Property Identity
Asset Registration
Certificates
Civil Documents
```

`AXCIVIL` không tự tạo ra luật.

Nó thực thi các quy tắc và authority được cung cấp bởi:

```text
AXLAW
```

và sử dụng identity infrastructure của:

```text
AXIDENTITY
```

---

# 704.1 — Core Principle

Nguyên tắc nền tảng:

> **Civil registry records facts and legally recognized states; it does not invent them.**

Do đó:

```text
AXLAW
   ↓
Civil Authority
   ↓
AXCIVIL
   ↓
Civil Record
```

Không:

```text
AXCIVIL
   ↓
invent legal status
   ↓
modify rights
```

nếu không có authority tương ứng.

---

# 704.2 — Civil-State Model

Civil state phải được biểu diễn dưới dạng các facts có provenance:

```axiom
civil_fact {
    fact_id
    subject
    type
    value
    jurisdiction
    authority
    effective_time
    recorded_time
    provenance
    status
}
```

Một fact không chỉ là:

```text
married = true
```

mà phải chứa:

```text
who
what
when
where
under which authority
from which source
```

---

# 704.3 — Fact vs Derived State

Phải phân biệt:

```text
registered_fact
derived_state
application_result
```

Ví dụ:

```text
birth_record
    ↓
age = derived_state
```

hoặc:

```text
marriage_record
+
divorce_record
    ↓
current_marital_status
```

Derived state có thể được tính lại từ authoritative facts.

---

# 704.4 — Vital Records

Core registry phải hỗ trợ:

```text
BIRTH
DEATH
MARRIAGE
DIVORCE
STILLBIRTH
ADOPTION
```

Các loại bổ sung phải được mở rộng bằng registry type system, không hard-code compiler.

---

# 704.5 — Birth Record

Canonical structure:

```axiom
birth_record {
    record_id
    child
    date_time
    place
    jurisdiction
    parentage
    registration_authority
    registration_time
    status
}
```

Phải hỗ trợ:

```text
single birth
multiple birth
delayed registration
amended registration
foreign birth registration
```

---

# 704.6 — Parentage

Parentage là relationship có provenance:

```axiom
parentage {
    child
    parent
    relationship_type
    authority
    effective_time
    evidence
    status
}
```

Không được suy ra parentage chỉ từ:

```text
co-residence
surname
genetic similarity
```

nếu pháp luật yêu cầu một thủ tục hoặc authority cụ thể.

---

# 704.7 — Parentage Types

Runtime phải hỗ trợ extensible relationship types:

```text
LEGAL_PARENT
BIOLOGICAL_PARENT
ADOPTIVE_PARENT
GUARDIAN
OTHER_LEGAL_RELATION
```

Các semantics khác nhau phải được giữ riêng.

---

# 704.8 — Death Record

```axiom
death_record {
    record_id
    subject
    date_time
    place
    jurisdiction
    registering_authority
    status
}
```

Death record phải có provenance rõ ràng.

Không cho phép application tùy tiện chuyển:

```text
ACTIVE_PERSON
→ DEAD
```

mà không qua authorized transition.

---

# 704.9 — Identity State Boundary

`AXCIVIL` không sở hữu toàn bộ identity.

Boundary:

```text
AXIDENTITY
    ↓
Identity
    ↓
AXCIVIL
    ↓
Civil Status
```

Ví dụ:

```text
person_id
```

thuộc identity system.

Trong khi:

```text
birth_record
marriage_record
death_record
```

thuộc civil registry.

---

# 704.10 — Name Model

Tên phải được model như temporal records:

```axiom
name_record {
    subject
    name
    type
    valid_from
    valid_to
    authority
    status
}
```

Hỗ trợ:

```text
birth name
legal name
preferred name
former name
alias
```

Không được overwrite lịch sử tên.

---

# 704.11 — Name Change

Lifecycle:

```text
REQUESTED
    ↓
REVIEW
    ↓
AUTHORIZED
    ↓
REGISTERED
    ↓
EFFECTIVE
```

Nếu bị từ chối:

```text
REQUESTED
    ↓
DENIED
```

Không được tạo civil fact mới trước authorization.

---

# 704.12 — Marriage Model

Marriage phải là relationship entity:

```axiom
marriage {
    marriage_id
    parties
    jurisdiction
    ceremony_time
    registration_time
    authority
    status
}
```

Status:

```text
PROPOSED
REGISTERED
ACTIVE
TERMINATED
VOIDED
```

Các status phải có semantics pháp lý riêng.

---

# 704.13 — Marriage Invariants

Runtime phải ngăn các state transition không hợp lệ theo rule set hiện hành.

Ví dụ:

```text
cannot terminate non-existing marriage
cannot modify finalized registration without amendment
cannot create duplicate canonical registration
```

Các rule cụ thể thuộc jurisdiction layer.

---

# 704.14 — Divorce

Divorce không phải đơn giản:

```text
married = false
```

Mà là authoritative event:

```axiom
divorce_record {
    divorce_id
    marriage_id
    authority
    effective_time
    registration_time
    consequences
    status
}
```

---

# 704.15 — Civil Status

Current status phải là derived projection:

```text
civil_facts
    ↓
status engine
    ↓
current civil status
```

Ví dụ:

```text
SINGLE
MARRIED
DIVORCED
WIDOWED
```

Danh sách status không được hard-code thành một enum toàn cầu nếu jurisdiction có semantics khác.

---

# 704.16 — Adoption

Adoption phải được model như legal relationship transition:

```text
existing parentage state
        ↓
adoption authority
        ↓
new legal parentage state
```

Historical relationship không được xóa vật lý.

---

# 704.17 — Guardianship

```axiom
guardianship {
    guardian
    ward
    authority
    scope
    start
    end
    limitations
    status
}
```

Scope có thể giới hạn:

```text
education
medical
financial
legal
general
```

---

# 704.18 — Household

Household là derived/social structure, không mặc định đồng nghĩa với legal family.

```axiom
household {
    household_id
    members
    residence
    effective_period
    source
}
```

Không được suy ra:

```text
same household → parent
same household → spouse
```

---

# 704.19 — Residency

Residency phải là temporal relationship:

```axiom
residency {
    subject
    location
    type
    valid_from
    valid_to
    authority
}
```

Hỗ trợ:

```text
primary residence
temporary residence
registered residence
historical residence
```

---

# 704.20 — Address Model

Address phải là structured data:

```text
country
region
district
locality
street
building
unit
postal_code
```

Không phụ thuộc vào một quốc gia cụ thể.

---

# 704.21 — Property Registry

`AXCIVIL` phải cung cấp abstraction cho property identity:

```axiom
property {
    property_id
    property_type
    jurisdiction
    location
    identifiers
    status
}
```

Property không nhất thiết là real estate.

Có thể có:

```text
LAND
BUILDING
VEHICLE
VESSEL
AIRCRAFT
REGISTERED_ASSET
```

Các specialized registries có thể xây trên core.

---

# 704.22 — Property vs Ownership

Phải tách:

```text
Property
Ownership
Possession
UseRight
Lien
Restriction
```

Không được:

```text
owner == possessor
```

mặc định.

---

# 704.23 — Ownership Model

```axiom
ownership {
    asset
    owner
    share
    authority
    valid_from
    valid_to
    status
}
```

Phải hỗ trợ:

```text
single owner
joint ownership
fractional ownership
corporate ownership
trust-like structures
```

theo jurisdiction rules.

---

# 706.1 — Core Principle

Nguyên tắc nền tảng:

> **AXFINANCE records and executes authorized financial state transitions with exact monetary semantics.**

Không được sử dụng floating-point làm authoritative monetary representation.

Không được để:

```text
AI

# BOOTSTRAP-707 — AXHEALTH: Native Healthcare, Medical Records, Clinical Workflow, Pharmacy, Laboratory, Public Health & Health-Data Runtime 5.0

**Namespace:** `AXHEALTH`  
**Phase:** Axiom Civilization Runtime / Healthcare Infrastructure  
**Status:** ARCHITECTURAL BASELINE — FROZEN TARGET  
**Depends on:** `AXLAW`, `AXIDENTITY`, `AXCIVIL`, `AXGOV`, `AXFINANCE`

---

# 707.0 — Mục tiêu

`AXHEALTH` là runtime native của Axiom cho **healthcare information, clinical state, medical records, care workflows, laboratory, pharmacy, appointments, procedures, insurance interfaces và public-health data**.

Mục tiêu không phải biến Axiom thành một hệ thống y tế cụ thể, mà cung cấp một semantic runtime đủ tổng quát để xây dựng:

```text
hospital systems
clinic systems
electronic health records
laboratory information systems
pharmacy systems
medical imaging systems
telemedicine
health insurance systems
emergency care systems
public-health systems
clinical research systems
```

Core principle:

> `AXHEALTH` quản lý dữ liệu và workflow y tế có provenance, authorization và temporal semantics; không tự biến dữ liệu thành chẩn đoán hay quyết định y khoa có thẩm quyền.

---

```text

Laboratory Result

Allergy

```

Không dùng một generic `medical_record` object thay thế toàn bộ.

---

### 704.1. Mục tiêu

Axiom phải có một mô hình native application hoàn chỉnh từ:

```text
Axiom Source
    ↓
Compiler
    ↓
Native Object
    ↓
Static/Dynamic Library
    ↓
Executable
    ↓
Application Package
    ↓
Install / Deploy
    ↓
Run
    ↓
Update / Rollback
```

Packaging và deployment **không được làm thay đổi semantics của chương trình** và không được biến Axiom thành runtime-dependent language.

---

### 704.2. Native artifact hierarchy

Chuẩn Axiom phân biệt rõ:

```text
.axsrc        source
.axmod        module/interface metadata
.axobj        native object
.axlib        static library
.axdylib      dynamic library
.axexe        executable description/artifact
.axpkg        application package
.axsym        symbol/debug metadata
.axmeta       compiler/semantic metadata
```

Các phần mở rộng trên là **logical artifact classes**, không bắt buộc filesystem phải sử dụng đúng extension đó.

Target-native output vẫn phải hỗ trợ:

```text
Windows → PE/COFF / EXE / DLL
Linux   → ELF / executable / shared object
macOS   → Mach-O / executable / dylib
iOS     → Mach-O application framework/bundle structures
Android → ELF + platform package structures
WASM    → WebAssembly module/component
```

---

### 704.3. Package model

`axpkg` là container deterministic gồm:

```text
manifest
executable
libraries
resources
metadata
signatures
debug symbols (optional)
platform data
```

Package không được chứa compiler bắt buộc để chạy application.

Runtime dependency chỉ xuất hiện khi application **chủ động sử dụng** một hệ thống runtime/library tương ứng.

---

### 704.4. Application manifest

Manifest phải mô tả tối thiểu:

```text
application identity
version
target
architecture
entry point
required capabilities
required resources
dependencies
embedded libraries
configuration
signing information
update policy
```

Ví dụ mô hình:

```text
application:
    id      = "com.example.app"
    version = "1.4.0"

target:
    os   = windows
    arch = x64

entry:
    main = "app.main"

capabilities:
    filesystem
    network
    process

dependencies:
    graphics >= 1.2
```

Manifest là **declarative metadata**, không phải executable code.

---

### 704.5. Version identity

Axiom phân biệt:

```text
application version
package version
ABI version
API version
module version
dependency version
```

Không được dùng một version number duy nhất để đại diện cho tất cả.

Compiler phải có khả năng xác định:

```text
same source
same compiler semantics
same dependencies
same target
same build configuration
        ↓
same artifact identity
```

khi deterministic build được bật.

---

Không cho phép:

Application không được phụ thuộc ngầm vào một bản compiler cụ thể trên máy người dùng.

### 704.11. Installation model

```text

repair
uninstall
upgrade
downgrade
verify
rollback
```

```text
BEGIN
  validate
  stage
  verify
  commit
END
```

Nếu thất bại:

```text
ROLLBACK
```

Không để application ở trạng thái half-installed.

### 704.12. Atomic deployment

Deployment directory không được trực tiếp overwrite executable đang chạy.

Mô hình:

```text
App/
 ├── versions/
 │    ├── 1.0.0/
 │    ├── 1.1.0/
 │    └── 1.2.0/
 │
 └── current → versions/1.2.0
```

Cơ chế cụ thể có thể thay đổi theo OS nhưng semantics phải giữ nguyên:

```text
old version
      ↓
new version staged
      ↓
verified
      ↓
atomic activation
```

---

### 704.13. Update model

Update phải hỗ trợ:

```text
full update
delta update
resource-only update
library-only update
configuration migration
```

Update không được yêu cầu tải lại những artifact không thay đổi khi delta update được sử dụng.

---

### 704.14. Rollback

Mỗi update phải có rollback boundary.

Nếu:

```text
installation succeeds
activation succeeds
application startup fails
```

hệ thống có thể phát hiện startup failure và phục hồi version trước đó nếu policy cho phép.

Rollback metadata:

```text
previous version
new version
activation timestamp
migration state
failure reason
```

---

### 704.15. Configuration migration

Version update có thể thay đổi configuration schema.

Axiom định nghĩa:

```text
config schema version
migration step
migration result
rollback compatibility
```

Migration phải chạy trước khi version mới được coi là healthy.

---

### 704.16. Package integrity

Package hỗ trợ:

```text
cryptographic hash
manifest hash
artifact hash
dependency hash
signature
```

Hash được sử dụng để phát hiện corruption.

Signature được sử dụng để xác thực provenance/trust.

Integrity và authenticity là **hai khái niệm độc lập**.

---

### 704.17. Signing

Package signing model:

```text
payload
   ↓
canonical manifest
   ↓
hash
   ↓
signature
```

Signature không được phụ thuộc vào thứ tự filesystem hoặc metadata không deterministic.

Cho phép:

```text
developer signing
release signing
enterprise signing
platform signing
```

---

### 704.18. Reproducible packaging

Khi:

```text
reproducible = true
```

package phải loại bỏ hoặc canonicalize:

```text
timestamps
filesystem ordering
random identifiers
machine-local paths
temporary compiler data
```

Hai build tương đương phải có khả năng tạo artifact byte-identical khi cùng toolchain/input/configuration.

Deployment abstraction phải hỗ trợ:

```text

CLI
service
mobile
embedded
WASM/web
container
portable application
```

Compiler core không được chứa platform-specific deployment logic.

Kiến trúc:

```text

Artifact Model
      ↓
Package Model
      ↓
Platform Adapter
```

---

### 704.20. Portable application

Axiom hỗ trợ portable deployment:

```text
app/
 ├── executable
 ├── libs/
 ├── resources/
 ├── config/
 └── manifest
```

Application có thể chạy mà không cần installation state toàn hệ thống nếu platform cho phép.

---

### 704.21. System installation

Khi cài system-wide, package manager phải quản lý:

```text
files
versions
dependencies
permissions
services
shortcuts
file associations
protocol handlers
uninstall metadata
```

Không được để application tự ý tạo persistent system state ngoài manifest/capability declaration.

---

### 704.22. Service deployment

Axiom executable có thể khai báo:

```text
application type = service
```

Service metadata:

```text
start mode
restart policy
dependencies
identity
capabilities
resource limits
health endpoint
shutdown behavior
```

Platform adapter chuyển metadata thành cơ chế service tương ứng của OS.

---

### 704.23. Health state

Deployment manager định nghĩa:

```text
installed
staged
activated
starting
healthy
degraded
failed
rollback-pending
rolled-back
uninstalled
```

Application có thể báo:

```text
startup complete
ready
healthy
degraded
shutdown
```

---

### 704.24. Crash-safe activation

Activation phải chịu được:

```text
power loss
process termination
machine restart
disk error
partial write
```

State machine phải đảm bảo không tồn tại trạng thái không xác định giữa:

```text
old version
new version
```

---

### 704.25. Package cache

Compiler/build system được phép duy trì:

```text
artifact cache
dependency cache
package cache
symbol cache
resource cache
```

Cache key phải chứa đủ semantic inputs để tránh:

```text
stale artifact
ABI mismatch
wrong target
wrong optimization
wrong compiler semantics
```

---

### 704.26. Package garbage collection

Artifact không còn được tham chiếu có thể được thu hồi:

```text
unused package
unused version
unused cache artifact
unused temporary deployment
```

Không được xóa version đang active.

Rollback-protected versions phải được giữ lại theo policy.

---

### 704.27. Offline deployment

Package đã hoàn chỉnh phải có thể triển khai offline nếu tất cả dependency cần thiết đã được đóng gói.

Không được có implicit:

```text
internet dependency
compiler download
package registry lookup
```

trong quá trình chạy application.

---

### 704.28. Registry/repository model

Axiom package registry là **distribution layer**, không phải một phần của language semantics.

Registry có thể cung cấp:

```text
package discovery
version metadata
artifact download
signature verification
dependency resolution
```

Compiler vẫn phải có khả năng build/deploy từ local artifacts.

---

### 704.29. Deployment security boundary

Package không được tự động có quyền:

```text
filesystem
network
process creation
device access
credentials
system modification
```

chỉ vì package đã được cài đặt.

Capability declaration phải được xử lý riêng theo security model đã khóa ở các bootstrap trước.

---

### 704.30. Compiler/package separation

Compiler phải cung cấp API/model tương đương:

```text
compile()
link()
package()
verify()
sign()
install()
deploy()
update()
rollback()
```

nhưng:

```text
compile
link
package
```

là compiler/build concerns;

còn:

```text
install
deploy
update
rollback
```

là deployment-system concerns.

Không được đưa deployment policy vào semantic compiler core.

---

### 704.31. CLI contract

Toolchain chuẩn:

```text
axiom build
axiom link
axiom package
axiom verify
axiom sign
axiom install
axiom deploy
axiom update
axiom rollback
axiom uninstall
```

Các command phải có:

```text
--target
--arch
--configuration
--output
--manifest
--offline
--reproducible
--verify
--sign
```

và machine-readable output:

```text
--format=json
```

để AI/tooling có thể điều khiển compiler.

---

### 704.32. AI-readable deployment metadata

Package phải có metadata machine-readable:

```text
artifact identity
source fingerprint
compiler fingerprint
target
ABI
dependencies
capabilities
resources
version
signature
build provenance
```

Mục tiêu là AI agent có thể xác định:

```text
artifact này được build từ đâu?
target nào?
ABI nào?
dependency nào?
có thể rebuild không?
có thể update không?
```

mà không cần phân tích binary thủ công.

---

### 704.33. Conformance tests

Bắt buộc có test cho:

```text
package creation
deterministic packaging
manifest validation
dependency resolution
resource packaging
signature verification
corrupted package detection
atomic installation
interrupted installation
rollback
update
downgrade
configuration migration
offline deployment
portable deployment
dynamic library resolution
cache invalidation
uninstall
```

Đặc biệt phải test fault injection:

```text
kill process
disk full
partial write
invalid signature
corrupted artifact
missing dependency
ABI mismatch
power-loss simulation
```

---

### 704.34. Normative invariants

Axiom deployment implementation **MUST** bảo đảm:

```text
D1. Installed artifact is self-describing.
D2. Package integrity is verifiable.
D3. Signed package authenticity is independently verifiable.
D4. Installation is transactional.
D5. Activation is atomic.
D6. Failed deployment can recover.
D7. Active version cannot be accidentally deleted.
D8. Dependency resolution is deterministic.
D9. Reproducible builds can produce reproducible packages.
D10. Deployment does not require compiler presence.
D11. Platform-specific behavior is isolated behind adapters.
D

# BOOTSTRAP-708 — AXEDUCATION: Native Education, Student Records, Curriculum, Assessment, Credential, Learning Workflow & Knowledge-State Runtime 5.0

**Namespace:** `AXEDUCATION`  
**Phase:** Axiom Civilization Runtime / Education Infrastructure  
**Status:** ARCHITECTURAL BASELINE — FROZEN TARGET  
**Depends on:** `AXLAW`, `AXIDENTITY`, `AXCIVIL`, `AXGOV`, `AXFINANCE`, `AXHEALTH`

---

# 708.0 — Mục tiêu

`AXEDUCATION` là runtime native của Axiom cho:

```text
student records
learner identity
schools
universities
teachers
courses
curriculum
classes
enrollment
attendance
assignments
assessment
examinations
grades
learning progress
credentials
certificates
transcripts
academic research
education finance
```

Mục tiêu là tạo một **education semantic runtime** đủ tổng quát để xây dựng:

```text
school management systems
university systems
LMS
online learning platforms
examination systems
student information systems
credential systems
vocational training
professional certification
research education platforms
AI tutoring systems
```

Core principle:

> `AXEDUCATION` quản lý authoritative educational state, learning records, assessment và credentials; không tự biến một dự đoán AI thành sự thật về năng lực hoặc thành tích của người học.

---

# 708.1 — Domain Boundary

Các khái niệm phải được phân biệt:

```text
Person
Learner
Student
Teacher
Instructor
Organization
Institution
Campus
Program
Curriculum
Course
Class
Enrollment
Learning Activity
Assessment
Grade
Credential
Certificate
Transcript
Attendance
Academic Event
```

Không dùng một `student_record` khổng lồ thay thế toàn bộ domain.

---

# 708.2 — Identity Boundary

`AXIDENTITY` sở hữu identity.

`AXEDUCATION` sở hữu:

```text id="x1"
learner_record
student_record
academic_identifier
enrollment
academic_history
```

Một người có thể:

```text id="x2"
study_at(A)
study_at(B)
enroll(program_A)
enroll(program_B)
```

đồng thời hoặc theo thời gian.

---

# 708.3 — Learner

```axiom id="x3"
learner {
    learner_id
    identity_reference
    status
    created_at
}
```

`learner` là abstract education participant.

---

# 708.4 — Student

Student là learner đang hoặc đã tham gia một institutional education context:

```axiom id="x4"
student_record {
    student_id
    learner
    institution
    identifiers
    status
    admitted_at
    closed_at
}
```

---

# 708.5 — Academic Identifier

Có thể có:

```text id="x5"
student_number
campus_id
national_education_id
exam_candidate_id
credential_id
```

Mỗi identifier:

```text id="x6"
issuer
value
valid_from
valid_to
status
```

---

# 708.6 — Educator

```axiom id="x7"
educator {
    educator_id
    identity_reference
    roles
    qualifications
    organizations
    status
}
```

Roles:

```text id="x8"
teacher
lecturer
professor
trainer
examiner
advisor
mentor
administrator
```

---

# 708.7 — Institution

```axiom id="x9"
education_institution {
    institution_id
    type
    name
    jurisdiction
    campuses
    programs
    status
}
```

Có thể:

```text id="x10"
school
college
university
vocational_center
training_center
online_institution
research_institution
```

---

# 708.8 — Campus

```axiom id="x11"
campus {
    campus_id
    institution
    location
    facilities
    status
}
```

---

# 708.9 — Education Program

```axiom id="x12"
education_program {
    program_id
    institution
    name
    level
    duration
    curriculum
    credential
    status
}
```

---

# 708.10 — Education Levels

Core không hard-code hệ thống giáo dục của một quốc gia.

Có thể biểu diễn:

```text id="x13"
early_childhood
primary
secondary
vocational
undergraduate
graduate
doctoral
professional
continuing
custom
```

---

# 708.11 — Curriculum

```axiom id="x14"
curriculum {
    curriculum_id
    program
    version
    effective_from
    effective_to
    requirements
    courses
}
```

Curriculum phải versioned.

---

# 708.12 — Curriculum Versioning

Không thay đổi curriculum historical record.

```text id="x15"
Curriculum v1
    ↓
Curriculum v2
```

Student đã học theo v1 vẫn reference v1.

---

# 708.13 — Course

```axiom id="x16"
course {
    course_id
    code
    title
    description
    credits
    prerequisites
    learning_outcomes
    status
}
```

---

# 708.14 — Course ≠ Class

Phải phân biệt:

```text id="x17"
Course
  =
academic definition

Class / Section
  =
specific offering
```

Ví dụ:

```text id="x18"
CS101
    ├── CS101-A
    ├── CS101-B
    └── CS101-ONLINE
```

---

# 708.15 — Course Section

```axiom id="x19"
course_section {
    section_id
    course
    instructor
    term
    schedule
    capacity
    location
    status
}
```

---

# 708.16 — Academic Term

```axiom id="x20"
academic_term {
    term_id
    institution
    start
    end
    enrollment_window
    grading_window
    status
}
```

Không giả định mọi institution dùng semester.

---

# 708.17 — Enrollment

```axiom id="x21"
enrollment {
    enrollment_id
    student
    program
    section
    term
    status
    enrolled_at
}
```

---

# 708.18 — Enrollment Lifecycle

```text id="x22"
REQUESTED
    ↓
ELIGIBILITY_CHECK
    ↓
APPROVED
    ↓
ENROLLED
```

Có thể:

```text id="x23"
WAITLISTED
DROPPED
WITHDRAWN
COMPLETED
CANCELLED
```

---

# 708.19 — Prerequisite

Prerequisite phải là explicit relation:

```axiom id="x24"
prerequisite {
    target_course
    requirement
    alternatives
    minimum_grade
}
```

Có thể hỗ trợ:

```text id="x25"
course
credit
credential
skill
placement_level
```

---

# 708.20 — Requirement

```axiom id="x26"
academic_requirement {
    requirement_id
    type
    expression
    minimum
    maximum
}
```

Expression có thể chứa:

```text id="x27"
AND
OR
NOT
minimum_credits
required_course
required_grade
required_credential
```

---

# 708.21 — Learning Outcome

```axiom id="x28"
learning_outcome {
    outcome_id
    course
    description
    competency
    proficiency_levels
}
```

Learning outcome phải là structured object.

---

# 708.22 — Competency

```axiom id="x29"
competency {
    competency_id
    domain
    description
    level
    evidence_requirements
}
```

---

# 708.23 — Knowledge State

Axiom education runtime có thể model:

```text id="x30"
knowledge_state {
    learner
    competency
    level
    evidence
    confidence
    measured_at
}
```

Nhưng:

```text id="x31"
AI estimate != authoritative achievement
```

---

# 708.24 — Learning Activity

```axiom id="x32"
learning_activity {
    activity_id
    learner
    course
    type
    started_at
    completed_at
    evidence
    status
}
```

Types:

```text id="x33"
lesson
reading
exercise
project
lab
discussion
lecture
simulation
practice
```

---

# 708.25 — Attendance

```axiom id="x34"
attendance {
    attendance_id
    student
    section
    session
    status
    recorded_at
    source
}
```

Status:

```text id="x35"
PRESENT
ABSENT
LATE
EXCUSED
REMOTE
UNKNOWN
```

---

# 708.26 — Attendance Provenance

Attendance source có thể là:

```text id="x36"
teacher
manual_entry
access_system
online_platform
device
approved_import
```

AI inference không mặc định là authoritative attendance.

---

# 708.27 — Assignment

```axiom id="x37"
assignment {
    assignment_id
    course
    title
    instructions
    due_at
    maximum_score
    rubric
    status
}
```

---

# 708.28 — Submission

```axiom id="x38"
submission {
    submission_id
    assignment
    learner
    content
    submitted_at
    version
    status
}
```

Submission phải immutable theo version.

---

# 708.29 — Submission Versioning

```text id="x39"
Submission v1
Submission v2
Submission v3
```

Không overwrite historical submission.

---

# 708.30 — Assessment

```axiom id="x40"
assessment {
    assessment_id
    learner
    course
    type
    evaluator
    criteria
    evidence
    result
    status
}
```

Types:

```text id="x41"
formative
summative
diagnostic
practical
oral
project
examination
portfolio
```

---

# 708.31 — Assessment ≠ Grade

Phải phân biệt:

```text id="x42"
assessment
    ↓
result
    ↓
grade
```

Assessment chứa evidence/process.

Grade là academic result.

---

# 708.32 — Assessment Evidence

Evidence:

```text id="x43"
submission
exam_response
project
practical_demonstration
oral_response
attendance
external_evidence
```

Evidence phải có provenance.

---

# 708.33 — Rubric

```axiom id="x44"
rubric {
    rubric_id
    criteria
    levels
    weights
    version
}
```

Rubric version phải được lưu với assessment.

---

# 708.34 — Grade

```axiom id="x45"
grade {
    grade_id
    learner
    course
    assessment
    value
    scale
    status
    evaluator
    awarded_at
}
```

---

# 708.35 — Grade Scale

Không hard-code:

```text id="x46"
A B C D F
```

Core phải hỗ trợ:

```text id="x47"
numeric
letter
percentage
pass_fail
competency_level
custom
```

---

# 708.36 — Grade Precision

Numeric grade phải có explicit precision và rounding.

Ví dụ:

```text id="x48"
89.95
```

không được tự động biến thành:

```text id="x49"
90
```

nếu policy chưa xác định rounding.

---

# 708.37 — Grade Override

Override phải là explicit event:

```text id="x50"
original_grade
    ↓
override_authority
    ↓
new_grade
    ↓
reason
```

Không sửa lịch sử.

---

# 708.38 — Grade Appeal

```axiom id="x51"
grade_appeal {
    appeal_id
    student
    grade
    grounds
    evidence
    authority
    status
}
```

Original grade vẫn tồn tại.

---

# 708.39 — Examination

```axiom id="x52"
examination {
    exam_id
    course
    version
    duration
    rules
    security_policy
    grading_policy
    status
}
```

---

# 708.40 — Exam Session

```axiom id="x53"
exam_session {
    session_id
    examination
    learner
    start
    end
    location
    proctor
    status
}
```

---

# 708.41 — Exam Attempt

```axiom id="x54"
exam_attempt {
    attempt_id
    session
    responses
    submitted_at
    status
}
```

Attempt phải immutable sau submission.

---

# 708.42 — Exam Security

Exam system phải hỗ trợ:

```text id="x55"
identity_verification
attempt_limits
time_limits
question_randomization
access_control
submission_integrity
audit
```

Không hard-code một cheating-detection mechanism.

---

# 708.43 — AI Exam Monitoring

AI có thể:

```text id="x56"
detect anomalies
assist proctoring
flag suspicious patterns
```

Nhưng:

```text id="x57"
AI flag != academic misconduct finding
```

Final determination phải theo institutional process.

---

# 708.44 — Academic Misconduct

```axiom id="x58"
academic_integrity_case {
    case_id
    student
    evidence
    allegation
    process
    authority
    status
    outcome
}
```

Evidence không tự động đồng nghĩa với guilt.

---

# 708.45 — Academic Integrity Lifecycle

```text id="x59"
FLAGGED
    ↓
REVIEW
    ↓
HEARING / EVALUATION
    ↓
DECISION
    ↓
APPEAL
    ↓
FINAL
```

---

# 708.46 — Course Completion

Course completion phải derive từ:

```text id="x60"
enrollment
+
requirements
+
assessment
+
grade
+
completion_policy
```

Không chỉ dựa vào attendance.

---

# 708.47 — Credit

```axiom id="x61"
academic_credit {
    value
    unit
    course
    learner
    awarded_at
    source
}
```

Có thể hỗ trợ:

```text id="x62"
credit_hour
ECTS_like
competency_credit
custom
```

---

# 708.48 — Transfer Credit

```axiom id="x63"
transfer_credit {
    source_institution
    source_course
    target_institution
    target_course
    equivalence
    authority
    status
}
```

Equivalence phải có explicit decision.

---

# 708.49 — Prior Learning

Có thể record:

```text id="x64"
prior_learning {
    learner
    evidence
    competency
    evaluator
    result
    authority
}
```

---

# 708.50 — Program Progress

```axiom id="x65"
program_progress {
    student
    program
    credits_completed
    credits_required
    requirements_met
    requirements_remaining
    status
}
```

Đây là derived state.

---

# 708.51 — Graduation Eligibility

```axiom id="x66"
graduation_evaluation {
    student
    program
    curriculum_version
    requirements
    completed
    missing
    evaluator
    result
}
```

Evaluation không tự động issue credential.

---

# 708.52 — Credential

```axiom id="x67"
credential {
    credential_id
    issuer
    holder
    type
    program
    requirements
    awarded_at
    status
}
```

Types:

```text id="x68"
degree
diploma
certificate
license
microcredential
badge
professional_credential
```

---

# 708.53 — Credential Issuance

```text id="x69"
ELIGIBILITY_CONFIRMED
    ↓
AUTHORIZED
    ↓
ISSUED
    ↓
PUBLISHED
```

Credential phải có issuer authority.

---

# 708.54 — Credential Verification

```axiom id="x70"
verify_credential(credential_id)
```

Result:

```text id="x71"
VALID
REVOKED
EXPIRED
UNKNOWN
INVALID
```

---

# 708.55 — Credential Revocation

Revocation không xóa credential history:

```text id="x72"
ISSUED
    ↓
REVOKED
```

Phải có:

```text id="x73"
authority
reason
timestamp
```

---

# 708.56 — Digital Credential

Credential có thể chứa:

```text id="x74"
issuer_signature
content_hash
credential_schema
issued_at
expiry
verification_endpoint
```

---

# 708.57 — Transcript

```axiom id="x75"
transcript {
    transcript_id
    student
    institution
    curriculum_versions

# 709.104 — Formal Invariants

```text
TRN-INV-01  AXTRANSPORT does not own person identity truth.
TRN-INV-02  Vehicle identity is distinct from registration.
TRN-INV-03  Vehicle ownership is not duplicated as authoritative transport state.
TRN-INV-04  Driver qualification is explicit and temporal.
TRN-INV-05  Road segments are versioned.
TRN-INV-06  Lane state is independently addressable.
TRN-INV-07  Traffic observations retain provenance.
TRN-INV-08  Unverified reports cannot silently become authoritative incidents.
TRN-INV-09  Route calculations retain their inputs and policy versions.
TRN-INV-10  Historical routes remain reproducible where required.
TRN-INV-11  Journey and operational trip are distinct.
TRN-INV-12  Static transit schedules are distinct from realtime state.
TRN-INV-13  Ticket issuance is distinct from payment settlement.
TRN-INV-14  Monetary settlement belongs to AXFINANCE.
TRN-INV-15  Permit authority belongs to AXGOV.
TRN-INV-16  Shipment history is immutable.
TRN-INV-17  Proof of delivery retains provenance.
TRN-INV-18  Telemetry is not automatically a legal fact.
TRN-INV-19  AI prediction is not automatically transportation state.
TRN-INV-20  AI traffic classification is not automatically authoritative.
TRN-INV-21  Autonomous control is separated from transport infrastructure state.
TRN-INV-22  Safety-critical control cannot depend on unverified external input.
TRN-INV-23  Offline operation cannot arbitrarily mint monetary or transport authority.
TRN-INV-24  Offline synchronization preserves event history.
TRN-INV-25  Distributed nodes cannot directly mutate authoritative state.
TRN-INV-26  Simulation cannot mutate production state.
TRN-INV-27  Transport policies are versioned.
TRN-INV-28  Historical state is replayable.
TRN-INV-29  Location access is capability-scoped.
TRN-INV-30  Exact mobility history is not public by default.
TRN-INV-31  Unit-incompatible calculations are rejected.
TRN-INV-32  Temporal validity is explicit.
TRN-INV-33  Traffic control actions require authorization.
TRN-INV-34  Emergency priority requires explicit authority.
TRN-INV-35  Cross-domain mutations use domain commands rather than direct state mutation.
```

# 710.105 — Formal Invariants

ENG-INV-01  Energy resource identity is distinct from ownership.
ENG-INV-02  Generation unit identity is stable across operational state changes.
ENG-INV-03  Grid topology is versioned.
ENG-INV-04  Historical topology cannot be destructively overwritten.
ENG-INV-05  Power and energy are distinct semantic types.
ENG-INV-06  Unit-incompatible arithmetic is rejected.
ENG-INV-07  Measured, estimated, corrected and predicted values are distinct.
ENG-INV-08  Meter corrections preserve original readings.
ENG-INV-09  Telemetry retains provenance.
ENG-INV-10  Grid state is timestamped.
ENG-INV-11  Breaker control requires explicit capability.
ENG-INV-12  Safety-critical commands require authorization.
ENG-INV-13  Stale commands cannot execute indefinitely.
ENG-INV-14  AI predictions are not authoritative physical measurements.
ENG-INV-15  AI recommendations cannot silently mutate grid state.
ENG-INV-16  Generation dispatch is explicitly recorded.
ENG-INV-17  Storage charge/discharge is event-based.
ENG-INV-18  Microgrid islanding is explicitly represented.
ENG-INV-19  Outage lifecycle is immutable and replayable.
ENG-INV-20  Protection events preserve provenance.
ENG-INV-21  Tariffs are versioned.
ENG-INV-22  Energy charge calculation retains tariff version.
ENG-INV-23  AXENERGY does not own the financial ledger.
ENG-INV-24  Market clearing does not directly mutate financial balances.
ENG-INV-25  Settlement is delegated to AXFINANCE.
ENG-INV-26  Permit authority belongs to AXGOV.
ENG-INV-27  Ownership references belong to AXCIVIL.
ENG-INV-28  Offline nodes cannot mint authority.
ENG-INV-29  Offline nodes cannot arbitrarily create financial settlement.
ENG-INV-30  Simulation cannot mutate production state.
ENG-INV-31  Replay is deterministic given identical event/policy versions.
ENG-INV-32  Critical control paths cannot depend on unverified external input.
ENG-INV-33  Manual override/fallback state exists for safety-critical control.
ENG-INV-34  Household-level energy data is capability-scoped.
ENG-INV-35  Cross-domain mutations use explicit commands/events.
```

# 711.105 — Formal Invariants

```text
WTR-INV-01  Water resource identity is distinct from ownership.
WTR-INV-02  Allocation is distinct from actual withdrawal.
WTR-INV-03  Actual withdrawal requires measurement or explicit estimation provenance.
WTR-INV-04  Reservoir topology is versioned.
WTR-INV-05  Water network topology is versioned.
WTR-INV-06  Historical infrastructure state is not destructively overwritten.
WTR-INV-07  Water volume and flow rate are distinct semantic quantities.
WTR-INV-08  Unit-incompatible arithmetic is rejected.
WTR-INV-09  Measurements retain timestamp and provenance.
WTR-INV-10  Measured, estimated, corrected and predicted states are distinct.
WTR-INV-11  Meter corrections preserve original readings.
WTR-INV-12  Water quality samples retain chain of custody.
WTR-INV-13  Laboratory results retain measurement method.
WTR-INV-14  Quality anomalies are not automatically contamination findings.
WTR-INV-15  AI predictions are not authoritative physical measurements.
WTR-INV-16  AI recommendations cannot silently execute water-control commands.
WTR-INV-17  Pump control requires explicit capability.
WTR-INV-18  Valve control requires explicit capability.
WTR-INV-19  Treatment control requires explicit capability.
WTR-INV-20  Safety-critical commands require authorization and validation.
WTR-INV-21  Expired commands cannot execute.
WTR-INV-22  Offline nodes cannot mint authority.
WTR-INV-23  Offline nodes cannot create arbitrary financial settlement.
WTR-INV-24  Water billing calculation is distinct from financial settlement.
WTR-INV-25  AXFINANCE owns monetary state.
WTR-INV-26  AXGOV owns permit authority.
WTR-INV-27  AXCIVIL owns authoritative civil ownership relationships.
WTR-INV-28  AXENERGY owns electrical state consumed by water infrastructure.
WTR-INV-29  AXTRANSPORT owns transport vehicle state.
WTR-INV-30  Potable and reclaimed water are distinct semantic states.
WTR-INV-31  Wastewater is distinct from potable-water distribution.
WTR-INV-32  Flood forecasts are not authoritative flood observations.
WTR-INV-33  Drought forecasts are not authoritative drought state.
WTR-INV-34  Simulation cannot mutate production state.
WTR-INV-35  Replay is deterministic given identical events and policy versions.
WTR-INV-36  Water-loss estimates preserve uncertainty.
WTR-INV-37  Fine-grained consumption data is capability-scoped.
WTR-INV-38  Cross-domain mutations use explicit commands/events.
WTR-INV-39  Infrastructure lifecycle history is append-only.
WTR-INV-40  Water-quality decisions retain supporting measurements and policy versions.
```

# 712.91 — Formal Invariants

```text
ENV-INV-01  Observation is distinct from measurement.
ENV-INV-02  Measurement retains provenance.
ENV-INV-03  Measured, estimated, calculated and predicted values are distinct.
ENV-INV-04  Historical measurements are not destructively overwritten.
ENV-INV-05  Corrections preserve original measurements.
ENV-INV-06  Sensor health is distinct from measurement validity.
ENV-INV-07  AQI is derived from source measurements.
ENV-INV-08  Pollutant identity is distinct from concentration.
ENV-INV-09  Emission source is distinct from emission event.
ENV-INV-10  Reported emission is distinct from measured emission.
ENV-INV-11  Climate observation is distinct from climate projection.
ENV-INV-12  Climate projection retains model and scenario metadata.
ENV-INV-13  Ecosystem is distinct from habitat.
ENV-INV-14  Species observation is distinct from population estimate.
ENV-INV-15  Population estimate retains uncertainty.
ENV-INV-16  AI species classification is not automatically authoritative.
ENV-INV-17  Environmental prediction is not automatically an observed event.
ENV-INV-18  Environmental anomaly is not automatically a legal violation.
ENV-INV-19  Environmental incident retains evidence provenance.
ENV-INV-20  Waste generation is distinct from waste processing.
ENV-INV-21  Waste custody history is append-only.
ENV-INV-22  Waste transport state belongs to AXTRANSPORT.
ENV-INV-23  Money belongs to AXFINANCE.
ENV-INV-24  Environmental permits derive authority from AXGOV/AXLAW.
ENV-INV-25  Environmental limits are versioned.
ENV-INV-26  Compliance evaluation retains applicable rule version.
ENV-INV-27  Simulation cannot mutate authoritative state.
ENV-INV-28  Forecast cannot mutate observation state.
ENV-INV-29  Replay is deterministic given identical event history and model versions.
ENV-INV-30  Uncertainty cannot be silently discarded.
ENV-INV-31  Precise endangered-species locations are capability-scoped.
ENV-INV-32  Offline sensors cannot create administrative authority.
ENV-INV-33  Remote-sensing observations retain acquisition metadata.
ENV-INV-34  Environmental datasets retain lineage.
ENV-INV-35  Environmental state is a projection over authoritative events.
ENV-INV-36  Cross-domain mutations use explicit commands/events.
ENV-INV-37  Water physical state remains authoritative in AXWATER.
ENV-INV-38  Energy physical state remains authoritative in AXENERGY.
ENV-INV-39  Transport physical/operational state remains authoritative in AXTRANSPORT.
ENV-INV-40  Legal determination is never silently inferred from environmental measurements.
```

# 713.0 — Mục tiêu

`AXAGRICULTURE` là native runtime mô hình hóa toàn bộ trạng thái và hoạt động nông nghiệp:

```text
farms
fields
soil operations
crops
cultivation
seeds
planting
irrigation
fertilization
pest management
harvesting
livestock
aquaculture
agricultural machinery
greenhouses
precision agriculture
farm telemetry
yield
agricultural resources
food production
storage
agricultural logistics
traceability
agricultural quality
biosecurity
```

Mục tiêu là tạo một semantic layer đủ mạnh để Axiom có thể xây dựng:

- farm-management systems;
- precision agriculture;
- autonomous agriculture;
- agricultural robotics;
- greenhouse systems;
- livestock management;
- aquaculture;
- crop simulation;
- yield prediction;
- agricultural marketplaces;
- food traceability;
- agricultural automation.

Nhưng `AXAGRICULTURE` **không sở hữu**:

```text
money       → AXFINANCE
water       → AXWATER
energy      → AXENERGY
transport   → AXTRANSPORT
environment → AXENVIRONMENT
civil owner → AXCIVIL
government  → AXGOV
law         → AXLAW
```

RTL-INV-04   Price is versioned.

RTL-INV-06   Promotion is distinct from applied discount.
RTL-INV-07   Cart is distinct from order.
RTL-INV-08   Checkout is distinct from payment settlement.
RTL-INV-09   Order is distinct from shipment.
RTL-INV-10   Inventory is distinct from available-to-sell.

RTL-INV-11   Reservation is distinct from sale.
RTL-INV-12   Inventory movements are immutable events.
RTL-INV-13   Inventory reservations are bounded by policy.
RTL-INV-14   Available-to-sell cannot exceed eligible inventory.
RTL-INV-15   Fulfillment allocation is traceable.
RTL-INV-16   Package contents are traceable to order lines.
RTL-INV-17   Shipment state belongs to AXTRANSPORT.
RTL-INV-18   Delivery evidence is preserved.
RTL-INV-19   Return request is distinct from return authorization.
RTL-INV-20   Return inspection is distinct from refund.

RTL-INV-21   Refund does not directly mutate financial balance.
RTL-INV-22   Exchange preserves original order lineage.
RTL-INV-23   Warranty is versioned.
RTL-INV-24   Customer identity belongs to AXIDENTITY.
RTL-INV-25   Product safety state belongs to source domain.
RTL-INV-26   Food safety state belongs to AXFOOD.
RTL-INV-27   Agricultural provenance belongs to AXAGRICULTURE.

RTL-INV-29   Legal rules belong to AXLAW.

RTL-INV-32   Review cannot become authoritative product fact.

```text

return(order_line)

refund(return)

split_inventory()

price_projection(version)

promotion_evaluation()
    deterministic for same inputs/version

offline_sync()
    preserves every valid event

duplicate_delivery_event()
    cannot duplicate business effect

simulation(snapshot)
    leaves authoritative state unchanged

# 716.76 — Formal Invariants

```text
LOG-INV-01   Shipment identity is immutable.
LOG-INV-02   Cargo is distinct from inventory.
LOG-INV-03   Shipment is distinct from transport trip.
LOG-INV-04   Transport execution belongs to AXTRANSPORT.
LOG-INV-05   Logistics planning cannot directly mutate vehicle state.
LOG-INV-06   Actual movement requires observable evidence.
LOG-INV-07   ETA is never treated as actual arrival.
LOG-INV-08   Warehouse identity is distinct from inventory state.
LOG-INV-09   Warehouse movement preserves lineage.
LOG-INV-10   Receiving cannot silently create unexplained inventory.

LOG-INV-11   Receiving discrepancies are preserved.
LOG-INV-12   Putaway is traceable.
LOG-INV-13   Pick operations are traceable.
LOG-INV-14   Pack operations preserve item lineage.
LOG-INV-15   Cross-dock operations preserve inbound/outbound lineage.
LOG-INV-16   Consolidation preserves child shipment identity.
LOG-INV-17   Deconsolidation preserves parent identity.
LOG-INV-18   Every shipment leg belongs to a shipment.
LOG-INV-19   Multimodal shipments preserve leg order.
LOG-INV-20   Delivery milestones preserve evidence.

LOG-INV-21   Forecast is distinct from actual demand.
LOG-INV-22   Supply plan is distinct from executed movement.
LOG-INV-23   Risk signal is distinct from actual disruption.
LOG-INV-24   AI output is derived.
LOG-INV-25   AI cannot directly override safety constraints.
LOG-INV-26   AI cannot mutate AXFINANCE ledger.
LOG-INV-27   AI cannot issue legal/customs decisions.
LOG-INV-28   AI cannot independently change food safety state.
LOG-INV-29   Simulation cannot mutate authoritative state.
LOG-INV-30   Digital twin state is derived.

LOG-INV-31   Cold-chain observation is distinct from food safety determination.
LOG-INV-32   Hazard classification is reference-based and versioned.
LOG-INV-33   Customs declaration is distinct from customs decision.
LOG-INV-34   Trade documents preserve provenance.
LOG-INV-35   Freight cost estimate is distinct from settlement.
LOG-INV-36   Financial settlement belongs to AXFINANCE.
LOG-INV-37   Reverse logistics preserves original shipment lineage.
LOG-INV-38   Recall logistics cannot redefine recall scope.
LOG-INV-39   Offline operations preserve local event provenance.
LOG-INV-40   Duplicate commands cannot duplicate physical business effects.
```

# 717.79 — Formal Invariants

```text
MFG-INV-01   Product is distinct from manufacturing definition.
MFG-INV-02   Product revisions are immutable once referenced by production history.
MFG-INV-03   BOM is versioned.
MFG-INV-04   Routing is versioned.
MFG-INV-05   BOM component quantities are explicit.
MFG-INV-06   Planned material is distinct from actual consumption.
MFG-INV-07   Production plan is distinct from work order.
MFG-INV-08   Work order is distinct from operation execution.
MFG-INV-09   Actual production quantities are preserved.
MFG-INV-10   Material transformation preserves lineage.

MFG-INV-11   Production output is distinct from byproduct.
MFG-INV-12   Scrap is separately represented.
MFG-INV-13   Production lots preserve genealogy.
MFG-INV-14   Material-to-product traceability is bidirectional.
MFG-INV-15   Machine identity is distinct from machine state.
MFG-INV-16   Telemetry is distinct from diagnosis.
MFG-INV-17   Machine safety state cannot be silently overridden.
MFG-INV-18   Quality measurement is distinct from quality decision.

```text id="spatial1"
coordinates
geometry
topology

spatial transformations
spatial indexing
maps
terrain

geofencing

# 721.53 — Formal Invariants

```text id="spatial43"
GEO-INV-01   Coordinate always has a defined CRS.
GEO-INV-02   Geometry preserves its CRS.
GEO-INV-03   Geometry version is immutable.
GEO-INV-04   Geometry history is replayable.
GEO-INV-05   Geometry is distinct from domain semantics.
GEO-INV-06   Address is distinct from coordinate.
GEO-INV-07   Spatial reference does not create ownership.
GEO-INV-08   Spatial reference does not create legal authority.
GEO-INV-09   Topology preserves node/edge relationships.
GEO-INV-10   Spatial indexes do not become authoritative state.

GEO-INV-11   Historical geometry remains queryable.
GEO-INV-12   Temporal geometry preserves validity intervals.
GEO-INV-13   Coordinate transformations preserve declared CRS semantics.
GEO-INV-14   Precision policy is explicit.
GEO-INV-15   Accuracy metadata is preserved.
GEO-INV-16   Uncertainty is not silently discarded.
GEO-INV-17   Spatial query results are derived.
GEO-INV-18   Route is distinct from transport trip.
GEO-INV-19   Routing graph version is preserved.
GEO-INV-20   Map layer is distinct from authoritative domain state.

GEO-INV-21   Raster metadata preserves source and CRS.
GEO-INV-22   Vector dataset preserves schema and CRS.
GEO-INV-23   Remote-sensing data preserves acquisition metadata.
GEO-INV-24   Large datasets may be externally stored without losing identity.
GEO-INV-25   Spatial partitions preserve global dataset identity.
GEO-INV-26   Offline spatial events preserve causal identity.
GEO-INV-27   Synchronization does not silently overwrite geometry.
GEO-INV-28   Reconciliation preserves competing versions.
GEO-INV-29   Replay reconstructs spatial state deterministically.
GEO-INV-30   Simulation cannot mutate authoritative spatial state.

GEO-INV-31   AI geometry is derived.
GEO-INV-32   AI cannot create legal boundaries.
GEO-INV-33   AI cannot change property rights.
GEO-INV-34   AI cannot alter jurisdiction.
GEO-INV-35   AI cannot autonomously issue legal restrictions.
GEO-INV-36   Geofence result does not automatically imply violation.
GEO-INV-37   Spatial event does not automatically imply legal event.
GEO-INV-38   Domain modules remain authoritative for domain semantics.
GEO-INV-39   Security policy can restrict spatial precision.
GEO-INV-40   Privacy transformations are auditable.
```

```text
TEL-INV-01   Every network node has a stable identity.
TEL-INV-02   Every network link has stable endpoints.
TEL-INV-03   Physical and logical links are distinct.
TEL-INV-04   Network topology is versioned.
TEL-INV-05   Topology history is replayable.
TEL-INV-06   Geometry references AXGEOSPATIAL.
TEL-INV-07   Equipment identity references AXASSET.
TEL-INV-08   Money references AXFINANCE.
TEL-INV-09   Legal authority references AXLAW/AXGOV.
TEL-INV-10   Subscriber identity references AXIDENTITY.

TEL-INV-11   Service state transitions are validated.
TEL-INV-12   Provisioning requires authorization.
TEL-INV-13   Configuration versions are immutable.
TEL-INV-14   Deployment references exact configuration versions.
TEL-INV-15   Rollback references a known valid version.
TEL-INV-16   Resource reservations are explicit.
TEL-INV-17   Reservation does not imply physical consumption.
TEL-INV-18   Capacity cannot become negative.
TEL-INV-19   QoS measurements are distinct from QoS policy.
TEL-INV-20   SLA is distinct from financial settlement.

TEL-INV-21   Alarm is distinct from fault.
TEL-INV-22   Fault is distinct from incident.
TEL-INV-23   Detection does not automatically establish root cause.
TEL-INV-24   Telemetry preserves source timestamps.
TEL-INV-25   Telemetry preserves sequence information.
TEL-INV-26   Offline events preserve causal identity.
TEL-INV-27   Synchronization is idempotent.
TEL-INV-28   Conflicting observations are not silently discarded.
TEL-INV-29   Reconciliation is auditable.
TEL-INV-30   Replay reconstructs deterministic state.

TEL-INV-31   AI output is derived.
TEL-INV-32   AI cannot create legal spectrum rights.
TEL-INV-33   AI cannot alter subscriber identity.
TEL-INV-34   AI cannot autonomously impose legal restrictions.
TEL-INV-35   AI cannot bypass safety controls.
TEL-INV-36   Simulation cannot mutate live state.
TEL-INV-37   Digital twin is not authoritative live state.
TEL-INV-38   Coverage prediction is distinct from service guarantee.
TEL-INV-39   Location privacy policies are enforceable.
TEL-INV-40   Sensitive subscriber operations are auditable.

digital twin

CMP-INV-01   Every compute node has stable identity.
CMP-INV-02   Every device belongs to a defined node.
CMP-INV-03   Every resource has explicit capacity.
CMP-INV-04   Capacity cannot become negative.
CMP-INV-05   Reservation is distinct from allocation.
CMP-INV-06   Allocation is distinct from execution.
CMP-INV-07   CPU/GPU/NPU are interchangeable only through capability contracts.
CMP-INV-08   Device capability must be declared.
CMP-INV-09   Memory domains are explicit.
CMP-INV-10   Data locality is explicit.

CMP-INV-11   Every workload has a stable identity.
CMP-INV-12   Every task belongs to a job/workload.
CMP-INV-13   Task dependencies are acyclic unless explicitly declared as streaming cycles.
CMP-INV-14   Workload state transitions are validated.
CMP-INV-15   Scheduling decisions are versioned.
CMP-INV-16   Placement references exact node/device versions.
CMP-INV-17   Resource requirements are validated before execution.
CMP-INV-18   Quotas are enforced before allocation.
CMP-INV-19   Preemption follows declared policy.
CMP-INV-20   Cancellation cannot silently report success.

CMP-INV-21   Checkpoints are immutable.
CMP-INV-22   Checkpoint restoration validates compatibility.
CMP-INV-23   Recovery preserves workload identity.
CMP-INV-24   Retry policy is explicit.
CMP-INV-25   Distributed execution preserves task identity.
CMP-INV-26   Offline execution preserves event sequence.
CMP-INV-27   Synchronization is idempotent.
CMP-INV-28   Conflicting resource observations are preserved.
CMP-INV-29   Reconciliation is auditable.
CMP-INV-30   Replay reconstructs deterministic control state.

CMP-INV-31   AI scheduling output is advisory.
CMP-INV-32   AI cannot bypass resource quotas.
CMP-INV-33   AI cannot bypass isolation.
CMP-INV-34   AI cannot silently mutate scheduling policy.
CMP-INV-35   AI cannot modify authoritative financial state.
CMP-INV-36   Simulation cannot mutate production state.
CMP-INV-37   Digital twin is not production state.
CMP-INV-38   Execution records preserve reproducibility metadata.
CMP-INV-39   Security boundaries are explicit.
CMP-INV-40   Sensitive workload and dataset access is auditable.

STG-INV-25   Distributed writes preserve transaction identity.
STG-INV-26   Offline writes preserve causal identity.
STG-INV-27   Synchronization is idempotent.
STG-INV-28   Conflicting writes are not silently discarded.
STG-INV-29   Reconciliation is auditable.
STG-INV-30   Replay reconstructs storage state.

`AXDATABASE` là database runtime native của Axiom, nằm **trên `AXSTORAGE` nhưng dưới các domain application**.

Mục tiêu không phải tạo một database engine duy nhất cho mọi trường hợp, mà cung cấp **một database semantic model thống nhất**, có thể compile xuống nhiều execution/storage strategy.

# 726.81 — Formal Invariants

```text
NET-INV-01   Every network interface has stable identity.
NET-INV-02   Every endpoint has explicit address family.
NET-INV-03   IPv4 and IPv6 semantics are distinct.
NET-INV-04   Stream semantics never imply message boundaries.
NET-INV-05   Datagram semantics never imply delivery guarantees.
NET-INV-06   Transport reliability is explicit.
NET-INV-07   Ordering guarantees are explicit.
NET-INV-08   Connection lifecycle is observable.
NET-INV-09   Async operations have explicit completion state.
NET-INV-10   Network buffers have explicit ownership.

NET-INV-11   Backpressure cannot be silently ignored.
NET-INV-12   Timeout behavior is explicit.
NET-INV-13   Retry policy is explicit.
NET-INV-14   Non-idempotent operations are not blindly retried.
NET-INV-15   Connection pooling cannot violate endpoint/security policy.
NET-INV-16   DNS cache entries have explicit lifetime.
NET-INV-17   DNS validation state is observable.
NET-INV-18   TLS state is explicit.
NET-INV-19   Authentication does not imply authorization.
NET-INV-20   Service identity does not equal network address.

NET-INV-21   RPC schemas are versioned.
NET-INV-22   RPC request/response types are validated.
NET-INV-23   Serialization cannot silently reinterpret incompatible fields.
NET-INV-24   Pub/sub delivery guarantees are explicit.
NET-INV-25   Message ordering scope is explicit.
NET-INV-26   Offline queues preserve message identity.
NET-INV-27   Duplicate delivery is detectable when required.
NET-INV-28   Network policy cannot be bypassed by protocol selection.
NET-INV-29   Capability checks occur before privileged network operations.
NET-INV-30   Raw packet access is explicitly privileged.

NET-INV-31   Network telemetry identifies observation time.
NET-INV-32   Network traces preserve operation ordering.
NET-INV-33   Simulation cannot mutate production network state.
NET-INV-34   Replay does not execute production side effects.
NET-INV-35   Geographic locality is not inferred solely from IP address.
NET-INV-36   AI recommendations cannot silently alter network authority.
NET-INV-37   AI cannot bypass network authorization.
NET-INV-38   Distributed failure states remain observable.
NET-INV-39   Network partition is distinguishable from service failure.
NET-INV-40   Zero-copy optimization cannot violate buffer ownership/lifetime.
```

# 727.94 — Formal Invariants

```text
SEC-INV-01   Authentication never implies authorization.
SEC-INV-02   Every privileged operation has an authorization decision.
SEC-INV-03   Capabilities cannot be expanded through delegation.
SEC-INV-04   Revoked capabilities cannot authorize new operations.
SEC-INV-05   Expired capabilities cannot authorize new operations.
SEC-INV-06   Security policies are versioned.
SEC-INV-07   Security decisions identify policy version.
SEC-INV-08   Deny is the default for unspecified privileged access.
SEC-INV-09   Principal identity cannot be inferred solely from network address.
SEC-INV-10   Service identity and human identity remain distinct.

SEC-INV-11   Cryptographic keys have explicit lifecycle state.
SEC-INV-12   Destroyed keys cannot be reported as active.
SEC-INV-13   Cryptographic algorithm metadata is explicit.
SEC-INV-14   Secure randomness is distinct from simulation randomness.
SEC-INV-15   Encryption authentication failures cannot produce valid plaintext.
SEC-INV-16   Nonce/IV requirements are enforced by the crypto API.
SEC-INV-17   Private key material cannot be exposed through public-key APIs.
SEC-INV-18   Secret material is excluded from normal telemetry.
SEC-INV-19   Key rotation preserves declared compatibility.
SEC-INV-20   Compromised keys can be revoked independently of identity.

SEC-INV-21   Certificate trust requires an explicit trust anchor/policy.
SEC-INV-22   Unknown certificate revocation state is not equivalent to valid.
SEC-INV-23   Attestation evidence identifies verifier and time.
SEC-INV-24   Sandbox policy is explicit.
SEC-INV-25   Sandbox escape is a security failure, not normal application behavior.
SEC-INV-26   Secure IPC identifies peer authority.
SEC-INV-27   Shared-memory authority is explicit.
SEC-INV-28   Security context cannot silently gain privileges across RPC.
SEC-INV-29   Confused-deputy execution is detectable/preventable by policy.
SEC-INV-30   Privileged operations are auditable when policy requires.

SEC-INV-31   Audit records preserve event ordering.
SEC-INV-32   Tamper-evident state identifies its integrity mechanism.
SEC-INV-33   Privacy classification does not automatically grant access.
SEC-INV-34   Purpose-bound access cannot silently become unrestricted access.
SEC-INV-35   Data minimization may not be bypassed by generic serialization.
SEC-INV-36   Security observations are not automatically authoritative incidents.
SEC-INV-37   AI security recommendations cannot silently change authority.
SEC-INV-38   AI cannot bypass authentication or authorization.
SEC-INV-39   Security simulation cannot mutate production security state.
SEC-INV-40   Security replay cannot create production side effects.
```
